title: 5.4.11 Challenges: Make it yours
description: The game is complete. Change one rule of your own: a narrower gap, pipes that speed up with the score, a best score that survives a crash, or a wobbling gap. Pick one; add an idea of your own on top if you like.

steps.title: Pick a rule and change it
steps.instructions: Choose one of the three challenges on the page above. The check turns green when any one of them is in your code, so one is enough. An idea of your own is welcome on top of it. Start from your finished 5.4.8.
hints: Whatever you pick, press R afterwards and check the game still starts cleanly.

steps.title: Name what you changed
steps.instructions: At the top of `script.js`, write one sentence as a `//` comment saying what your rule is and what would happen if you removed it.
hints: A rule is something the game decides. 'The gap shrinks every five points' is a rule; 'I changed a colour' is not.

requirements.title: Your rule is in the code
requirements.description: One of the three challenges is there: something depends on the score (harder as you go, or a best score), or the pipes use random for more than the gap height. Help: 5.4.7 (Lab: Score a gap) and 5.4.6 (Lab: Pipes that come and go)
